task_title: Speed up headless runs and weapon sweeps

plan_review.notes: Alternatives: intra-job workers alone rejected because 2-core runner overhead cannot reliably guarantee >=50%; raw subtile discovery rejected in favor of tile-level FloorMap APIs; LOS/flow-first rejected unless measured FOV/discovery work misses >=25%. Resolutions: transparency revision increments only on actual transparent-bit changes; FOV cache keys map identity, subFactor, origin and live transparency revision; bootstrap remains permissive until current/player tile visibility exists; runtime parity is proven before sharding; fan-in recreates exact per-weapon artifact names/schema and rejects missing, duplicate, or out-of-order tuples; benchmarks use warmed repeated runs, exclude runAt/wallTimeMs from determinism, and compare GitHub job execution time; cache-hit instrumentation and fresh profile trigger LOS/flow fallback if needed. Floor-map replacement naturally isolates discovered state; canonical Floor 1 runs never transition floors, and focused tests cover replacement.
